hooks.text: 角色、技能与神器自由组合，发展路线改变地牢攻略方法
hooks.excerpt: Combine characters, skills, and artifacts as you wish! Depending on what combinations and development paths players select, methods required for conquering the dungeon will change.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 普通、极速与挑战模式分别侧重逐层推进、Boss速攻和高难
hooks.excerpt: From the classic 'Normal Mode,' where players take down dungeons one at a time, to the 'Super Fast Mode,' which focuses on progress and boss attacks, and 'Challenge Mode,' which will ramp up the difficulty for more challenge, there are tons of modes for players to conquer and enjoy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 高质量复古像素角色与Boss配合多套角色皮肤
hooks.excerpt: This game is jam-packed full of characters and bosses rendered in high-quality pixel graphics! In addition to the colorful retro pixel action, players can pick from a number of skins to highlight each character's unique personality!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
